annotation.authors_or_issuer: Mataric, M.; Okamura, A.M.; Christensen, H.I. (Computing Community Consortium / CRA, NSF-funded workshop)
key_provisions_or_claims: Identifies societal drivers: access to care, affordability, aging, disability, and prevention.
Sets capability roadmap including physical HRI, behavior understanding, diagnosis, image-guided intervention, safe robot behavior.
Covers six strategic areas: surgery, function replacement, rehabilitation, behavioral therapy, special needs care, wellness.
Raises deployment issues and calls for basic research in formal methods, control, perception, and learning.
annotation.summary_en: A US research roadmap from a CRA/NSF-funded workshop on medical and healthcare robotics. It sets societal drivers, strategic areas (surgery, rehabilitation, prostheses, behavioral therapy, special-needs care, wellness), capability and research priorities, and deployment issues. It is a research agenda, not a governance instrument. The metadata title does not match the content.
annotation.title_clean: A Research Roadmap for Medical and Healthcare Robotics
annotation.title_en: A Research Roadmap for Medical and Healthcare Robotics
